<action type="say">
I can do that. I’ll collect a few details and then request quotes from multiple plumbers for you.

1) Location
• What’s the full address (or at least city + ZIP) where the work will be done?

2) The faucet/job details
• Is this:
  - Replacing an old faucet with a new one in the same spot, or
  - A brand‑new install where there wasn’t a faucet before?
• Do you already have the new faucet purchased? If yes, what type (pull‑down, touchless, brand/model if you know)?
• Is the sink already installed and the countertop in place?
• Is there anything unusual (e.g., very tight cabinet access, garbage disposal, water filter, old shutoff valves that look corroded)?

3) Timing
• When would you like this done? (specific date or “anytime next week,” etc.)
• Is this routine (no leak, just an install) or urgent?

4) Time window and contact
• What’s your preferred time window (morning, afternoon, evening, or a specific range like 9–12)?
• What name, email, and phone should I put on the quote request?

Reply with your answers in a quick list or paragraph, and I’ll turn that into a job description and pull in quotes.</action>
